decisions.topic: Google clients, audience, scopes and exact owned domains
decisions.proposal: Login-only scopes; environment-isolated clients and callbacks; no unrelated Google data/offline access.
Plan Sign in with Apple alongside Google for the primary account unless a qualifying alternative/exception is established for the actual product.
Web provider redirect with purpose-bound transaction; permitted native/system-browser flow with verified return and secure verifier/session handoff.

decisions.topic: Account linking, relay and invitation collision policy
decisions.proposal: Auth UUID is the ownership key; verify server automatic linking; explicit authenticated different-email linking; never merge finance or grants by client email.
Retain current SMTP route; repair purpose templates locally; signed Hook remains separate reviewed option and replaces SMTP when enabled.
Distinguish monitored support, security/Auth sender and optional application-event sender; verify existing sender/provider before creating or changing addresses.
Server-authorized durable event delivery distinct from Auth and Web Push; approve recipient/event/budget/retention rules before implementation/activation.
Exact staging pin/settings with separate recoverable identities/inboxes, provider readiness, selected native return and rollback; no production dispatch.
